title: Tracecat 1.1.0-alpha.10
body_markdown:
## Deployment compatibility


For Kubernetes, deploy this prerelease together with Helm chart **0.7.0** . Executor sandboxes now enforce memory with cgroup v2, and` nsjail` executors refuse to start without the sandbox cgroup bootstrap that chart 0.7.0 provides; do not upgrade only the application image on chart 0.6.0.` TRACECAT__SANDBOX_DEFAULT_MEMORY_MB` (` executor.sandboxMemoryMib` ) is now an aggregate budget per sandbox, and the per-process address-space guard defaults to twice that budget (` TRACECAT__SANDBOX_ADDRESS_SPACE_MB` ,` executor.sandboxAddressSpaceMib` ). Executors using the` direct` backend are unaffected.
